description: This pie chart, titled "6 Matches," visually represents the distribution of six distinct categories, labeled numerically from 0 to 5, which appear to correspond to different match counts or outcome levels. The chart is divided into six slices, each with a distinct color and labeled with its percentage, absolute count, and category number. The largest slice, colored light blue, corresponds to category 5 and accounts for 27.2% (8006) of the total. The second largest, a pale green slice labeled "2," represents 22.4% (6583). The remaining slices, in descending order of size, are: category 0 (light cream, 13.3%, 3910), category 1 (pale yellow, 13.8%, 4046), category 4 (light blue, 6.2%, 1810), and category 3 (light green, 6.8%, 2002). Each slice is clearly labeled with its percentage and count, and the category number is placed near the outer edge of the chart. The chart includes a legend, though it is not explicitly shown in the image, and the slices are arranged in a clockwise descending order by size, starting from the top.
